The '''End Stone Bow''' is an {{Epic}} [[Bow]] that requires {{Skill|Combat|15}} to use. It is a pretty good early-game bow and it can be used as a weaker alternative for the [[Runaan's Bow]].

The ability is a direct parallel to the [[End Stone Sword]].

== Usage ==
{{ItemInfo
|type = Bow
|name = End Stone Bow
|rarity = e
|damage = 140
|item_ability_name = Extreme Focus
|item_ability_description = Consumes all your {{Statname|Mana}}, and your next hit will deal that much more {{Statname|Damage}}!
|item_ability_activation = Left Click
|item_ability_mana_cost = All
}}
'''Note''': {{AN|Extreme Focus}} is only applied after all other damage boosters are applied. It does not trigger if a shot is missed. It also only applies to the '''End Stone Bow''' and cannot be stacked on other bows. 
It can also be [[salvaged]] for {{G|3}} {{item|Dragon Essence}}.

== Trivia ==
* The mana points are taken when the ability is used, not when the next arrow connects, making it possible to double fire the extreme focus by letting your mana charge, then using it again after your first shot connects.
